name: Perseus to Andromeda
original_name: ペルセウスとアンドロメダ
source:
Due to the success of the Silver Star Coin play, Satsuki and her class have been asked to do another performance. This time, Satsuki stars with her best friend, and both have to appear on stage completely naked...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ262561.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
得益于话剧《银星币》的大获成功，皋月与她所在的班级收到了再演一场的邀请。这一次，皋月将与自己的挚友联袂主演，而且两人竟然必须一丝不挂地全裸登台演出……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ262561.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
